name: When do I need to add an egress window during a basement remodel?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to add an egress window during a basement remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dedicated egress window is mandatory whenever your basement plan includes a finished legal bedroom, providing an accessible emergency exit. Adding an egress window requires cutting through your foundation wall, installing a reinforced window frame, and digging an exterior window well with a safety ladder and proper drainage. If you are only creating an open family entertainment space, craft area, or home office without sleeping quarters, existing code-compliant basement windows may suffice depending on local municipal rules.
acceptedAnswer.description: An egress window is required whenever you add a legal bedroom, ensuring safe emergency exit and compliance with local building codes.
